cues.text: Port Island Station, among the crowd. Keisuke stands facing you, a bag in his hand.
Keisuke has turned to leave when an old woman nearby collapses, coughing. He runs to her side, and you follow.
An old man sitting on a bench nearby slumps off it onto his hands and knees. Keisuke runs to him, dropping his bag on the ground, and you follow.
Keisuke runs off, and you kneel beside the old man.
